verdict.rationale: Browser Use has a dedicated first-party MCP server guide (/cloud/guides/mcp-server) for running browser automation tasks from Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, or any MCP client, and a probe confirms the page exists. One HN commenter said it lacked MCP integration, but that is an older complaint predating the documented server, not a hands-on failure of it. Missing for 10: details of the exposed tools, setup and auth in the evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works.
